notes.subject: מזח
notes.rationale: məzaḥ 'girdle/belt' occurs only here in the Tanakh.

notes.subject: מזח
notes.rationale: Rendered literally 'girdle' (mɔgɔtɛrɛ); KJV 'strength', ASV 'restraint', BSB 'harbor' all paraphrase.

notes.subject: כיאר
notes.rationale: ye'or is specifically the Nile; rendered 'baji' (great river) with comparison kept.

notes.subject: to Tarshish
notes.rationale: Imperatives addressed to 'daughter of Tarshish', the merchant power.

notes.subject: denmuso
notes.rationale: בת 'daughter' is an epithet for a city/people, not a literal daughter.

translation: Denmuso Tarshish, tɛmɛ i ka dugukolo kan i n'a fɔ baji — mɔgɔtɛrɛ si tɛ yen fo.
